title: EKET wall-mounted cabinet combination
description: EKET wall-mounted cabinet combination, walnut effect, 687/8x133/4x271/2" Dress your wall with cubes! Create a classic storage solution with just a few EKET cabinets or combine as many as you like in a fun and unexpected way to fit your needs and make your space more personal.
features: EKET suspension rails for wall mounting are included.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
The maximum load for a wall-hung cabinet depends on the wall material.
Ensure that you have a minimum of 2" between the top of the frame and the ceiling in order to mount the frame to the suspension rail.
